ValidationRule.description: if Sub-Category is Bad Survey Score, 'Complaint Code' can't be empty
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND(NOT(ISNEW()) , ISPICKVAL(Status, 'Closed'), OR(RecordType_Name__c ='IME SC Case',RecordType_Name__c ='IME SC Case Resolved'), ISPICKVAL(Origin, 'IM_Survey'), ISPICKVAL(IME_SC_Sub_Category__c, 'Bad Survey Score'), ISPICKVAL(IME_SC_Complaint_Code__c, ''))
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Complaint Code cannot be empty when case sub category is Bad Survey Score
